title: Health tick timer
description: This mod tracks till the next time you heal as well as gives you the exact amount of health you are at.
body:
# This mod was vibe coded 
Feel free to steal this code I don't care.
## Regen Timer
This mod will tell you your exact health as well as the exact tick you will naturally regen.

Features
Exact regen countdown — reads Minecraft's real internal healing timer (not an estimate) to show the exact tick/second until your next natural health regeneration, based on your current hunger and saturation.
Live health display — a second HUD element showing your current health (current-only or as a fraction of max), updating every tick.
Fully customizable — drag either HUD element anywhere on screen, snap them into alignment with each other, pick any color, and choose between ticks, seconds, or both for the regen timer.
One-click config — Mod Menu + YACL config screen, no commands to memorize.
How it works
Vanilla Minecraft heals you fast (every 10 ticks) when your hunger is full and you have saturation, or slow (every 80 ticks) once hunger is 18+. Regen Timer hooks directly into that internal timer, so the number you see is always exactly right.

Requirements
Fabric Loader, Fabric API
YetAnotherConfigLib (YACL) — required
Mod Menu — optional, for in-game settings access
